title: E7 Dual-Ended Eyebrow Brush
descriptionHtml:
✓ Vegan✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: A dual-ended eyebrow brush with angled bristles and spoolie ideal to fill and detail brows with powder or cream formulas.

Brush Formulation: All Formulas

Brush Coverage: Buildable

Bristle Type: Synthetic

Ingredient Callouts: It is cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: The soft angled side to fill and detail brows with powder or cream formulas for a fluffy, fuller look. Finish with the spoolie end to shape and define brows.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Mario uses Master Mattes® Eyeshadow Palette: The Neutrals to fill brows with a neutral matte finish using the E7 eyeshadow brush.
-All MAKEUP BY MARIO brushes are cruelty-free and made with a custom blend of synthetic and vegan fibers and 100 percent FSC-certified birchwood handles.
-Mario’s all-in-one tool for grooming and defining brows.
-Use the definer end of brush to apply powder in short, even strokes for natural, hair-like detail.
-Use the spoolie end to groom brow hairs and blend out color.
